mapper.select: SELECT user_email_verification_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, requested_at, request_count FROM t_user_email_verification WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash,jdbcType=BINARY} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY user_email_verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT max(requested_at) FROM t_user_email_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT count(*) FROM t_user_email_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND requested_at >= #{since}
